response.sql: WITH record_shares AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, traitcount::numeric / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM record_shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
